WORKERS_MODE.description: Application capacity policy: `free` (default) or `paid` (larger limits, for an account with Workers Paid enabled). This does not change your Cloudflare billing plan.

DEFAULT_PASSWORD.description: Initial administrator password. Keep your existing value when updating.

AUTH_SECRET.description: Independent 256-bit key: generate 64 random hexadecimal characters with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Keep the same key when switching modes or updating.
